answer: When an AI joins the market it must deposit a proof‑of‑stake token into the Juniper vault, then broadcast a signed Willow‑chain proof that its stake has been continuously bonded for a minimum epoch. Validators weight each node’s voting power by the square of its bonded amount, so a thousand identities each staking 1 token contribute the same weight as a single node staking 31 tokens (√1000≈31).
